description:
Ye-Ji, an 18-year-old student at Hana Arts High School, wants to win the world's best classical international violin competition held in Korea. She wants to fulfill her older sister Ye-Seo dream, who died a year ago. Ye-Ji practices repeatedly on the expensive violin "John Webster" that her older sister had borrowed from the DK Music Foundation, but Ye-Ji's mother, Su-Jin, has conflicts with Ye-Ji, who does not hesitate to abuse herself for practice, and eventually returns the violin to the music foundation. Ye-Ji, who believes that neither the competition nor the victory are meaningful without Webster, is about to give up everything when she receives a text message saying she has passed the final round of the competition. Will Ye-Ji be able to get John Webster back and win the competition? Ye-Ji's adventure in the city to get John Webster back begins now!

(Source: Naver, translated)
